bundled.built_from: Unmodified files extracted from the exact Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 binary packages in LIBRARIES.json and repacked with their data and copyright notices. LIBRARIES.json identifies each binary/source package and build input.

modifications: Unmodified official Ubuntu noble release binary. Bundled Lua plugins are omitted. A launcher confines the reference process and keeps application data under DATA_DIR. The launcher loads a local seccomp guard after application startup to prohibit all external program execution.
configuration: The launcher keeps state in DATA_DIR, uses English labels, starts GUI file dialogs in the inbox, and applies the reference filesystem/execution sandbox. Built-in Lua plugins are omitted.
